setting.en: A lighthouse on a rock, cut off by a storm.
setting.zh: 礁石上的一座灯塔，被风暴困住。

cause.en: Found at the foot of the lamp, struck with the winding handle. The lamp room was locked. The lamp had gone out, and in the dark no one in the room could see who struck.
cause.zh: 倒在灯座下，被摇柄击中。灯室当时锁着。当时灯灭了，屋里一片漆黑，在场的人看不见是谁动的手。

rules.en: Evidence is what proves something: the records and objects in your notebook. An item marked as a note is not evidence and proves nothing. What a suspect says proves nothing by itself, but hearing someone can open evidence that was closed.
rules.zh: 能证明事情的是证据：你笔记本里的记录和物证。标为“备注”的条目不算证据，不能证明任何事。嫌疑人说的话本身也不能证明任何事，但听某人说话，可能让你查到原本查不了的证据。

rules.en: To solve the case, accuse one person and cite evidence that together shows three things about them: they were at the scene at the time of death, they held what was needed, and they had a motive.
rules.zh: 要破案，须指认一个人，并引用证据，合起来证明三件事：死亡时刻此人在现场，此人持有作案所需之物，此人有动机。

rules.en: The evidence you cite must also rule out everyone else. A person is ruled out by evidence that places them somewhere else at that time, or that shows they did not hold what was needed, or that shows they had none of the motives listed in this case.
rules.zh: 你引用的证据还必须排除其他所有人。排除一个人，要有证据证明此人当时在别处，或证明此人没有持有所需之物，或证明本案列出的每一种动机此人都没有。

rules.en: A room's record lists the people who were seen there. It does not show that nobody else was. So being absent from the scene's record does not rule a person out.
rules.zh: 房间记录只列出在那里被看到的人，并不表示当时没有别人。所以，一个人不在现场记录上，并不算被排除。

text.en: Register for "A key to the lamp room": held by Aldric Varga, Cormac Brandt, Edmund Soler, Gideon Petrov and Leonie Eklund. Nobody else holds one.
text.zh: “灯室钥匙”登记：持有者为魏立群、柏康默、苏艾蒙、裴吉登、艾莱昂。其他人都没有。

text.en: The victim's papers: "Stood to lose their post in the inspector's report." This is true of Aldric Varga and Leonie Eklund.
text.zh: 死者的文件：“督察的报告会让此人丢掉职位。”符合这一条的有魏立群、艾莱昂。

text.en: The victim's papers: "Owed the victim money that was due this week." This is true of Cormac Brandt and Octavia Hadley.
text.zh: 死者的文件：“欠死者一笔本周到期的钱。”符合这一条的有柏康默、哈奥薇。

text.en: The victim's papers: "Had been refused a share of the salvage." This is true of Gideon Petrov.
text.zh: 死者的文件：“打捞所得的分成被拒绝。”符合这一条的有裴吉登。

text.en: The victim's papers give Edmund Soler none of the listed motives.
text.zh: 死者的文件表明，苏艾蒙不符合上述任何一条动机。

text.zh: 灯室的出入记录由欧碧翠保管。先听听这个人的说法。

setting.en: A lighthouse on a rock, cut off by a storm.
setting.zh: 礁石上的一座灯塔，被风暴困住。

cause.en: Found at the foot of the lamp, struck with the winding handle. The lamp room was locked. The lamp had gone out, and in the dark no one in the room could see who struck.
cause.zh: 倒在灯座下，被摇柄击中。灯室当时锁着。当时灯灭了，屋里一片漆黑，在场的人看不见是谁动的手。

rules.en: Evidence is what proves something: the records and objects in your notebook. An item marked as a note is not evidence and proves nothing. What a suspect says proves nothing by itself, but hearing someone can open evidence that was closed.
rules.zh: 能证明事情的是证据：你笔记本里的记录和物证。标为“备注”的条目不算证据，不能证明任何事。嫌疑人说的话本身也不能证明任何事，但听某人说话，可能让你查到原本查不了的证据。

rules.en: To solve the case, accuse one person and cite evidence that together shows three things about them: they were at the scene at the time of death, they held what was needed, and they had a motive.
rules.zh: 要破案，须指认一个人，并引用证据，合起来证明三件事：死亡时刻此人在现场，此人持有作案所需之物，此人有动机。

rules.en: The evidence you cite must also rule out everyone else. A person is ruled out by evidence that places them somewhere else at that time, or that shows they did not hold what was needed, or that shows they had none of the motives listed in this case.
rules.zh: 你引用的证据还必须排除其他所有人。排除一个人，要有证据证明此人当时在别处，或证明此人没有持有所需之物，或证明本案列出的每一种动机此人都没有。

rules.en: A room's record lists the people who were seen there. It does not show that nobody else was. So being absent from the scene's record does not rule a person out.
rules.zh: 房间记录只列出在那里被看到的人，并不表示当时没有别人。所以，一个人不在现场记录上，并不算被排除。

text.en: Register for "A key to the lamp room": held by Aldric Varga, Cormac Brandt, Edmund Soler, Gideon Petrov and Leonie Eklund. Nobody else holds one.
text.zh: “灯室钥匙”登记：持有者为魏立群、柏康默、苏艾蒙、裴吉登、艾莱昂。其他人都没有。

text.en: The victim's papers: "Stood to lose their post in the inspector's report." This is true of Aldric Varga and Leonie Eklund.
text.zh: 死者的文件：“督察的报告会让此人丢掉职位。”符合这一条的有魏立群、艾莱昂。

text.en: The victim's papers: "Owed the victim money that was due this week." This is true of Cormac Brandt and Octavia Hadley.
text.zh: 死者的文件：“欠死者一笔本周到期的钱。”符合这一条的有柏康默、哈奥薇。
